batting.dismissal: c AM Nayar b Yuvraj Singh

batting.name: SR Tendulkar
batting.dismissal: c MR Marsh b AJ Finch

batting.name: Yuvraj Singh
batting.dismissal: c R Dhawan b KA Pollard

batting.name: TL Suman
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b Harbhajan Singh

batting.name: AD Mathews
batting.dismissal: c RG Sharma b PP Ojha

batting.name: MR Marsh
batting.dismissal: c R Dhawan b MG Johnson

batting.name: AM Nayar
batting.dismissal: c KA Pollard b SL Malinga

balls.text: swings yet another full toss out to long on
Dinda losing it again, full toss on middle and off, Rohit sends it smoking wide of deep midwicket
and another six carries just over Ross Taylor's hands at long off, and that is fifty for Rohit Sharma, he's taken his time as always, and exploded
tries to play the ramp from well outside off, mishits it to square leg
around the blockhole outside off, squeezed out to the sweeper, so far, so good from Dinda
dabs a low full toss wide of point
low full toss, Pollard drills it down the ground, long on gets around in time
heaves a very full one through midwicket, and it goes slowly enough into the outfield for them to come through for two
in the blockhole once more, Rohit backing away but cannot turn it past backward point
another full toss outside off, and Rohit sends it to the deep extra cover rope with a step back in the crease and a crack of the bat
around the blockhole, Pollard manages a thick inside edge past the stumps
full and wide, Pollard finds point as he reaches for it
that is through the hands of Taylor at long off, length ball drilled flat in the air, Taylor has hands outstretched over his head, but it zooms through
high full toss, Rohit backs away to leg and swings hard, ends up slicing it high and wide of third man
it's Pollard time, gets under a length ball and sends it rocketing high over deep midwicket, that didn;t like it was every going to come down
slow bouncer, into the body, Pollard has swivelled and hooked it to the deep square leg boundary
length ball into middle and leg, worked straight to midwicket, Yuvraj throws at the striker's and it hits Pollard who is bending to make his ground, a few stares exchanged,
good length, Pollard powers it along the ground to long off
low full toss, he can;t get hold of the slog over midwicket
elegant, and effective, makes you wonder why he can't pull it off more often, forward to ease it through extra cover, and needs a dive from long off to save four
around the blockhole outside off, Rohit throws the bat at it, keeper does well to stop the screaming thick inside edge
how did that go for six, it was a slower one, and Rohit seemed to have mistimed the pull off the front foot, but it has sailed comfortably over wide long on, and Dinda has also overstepped
that'll go, Rohit getting under this overpitched delivery and hammering it high over long off
full and wide, he reaches out and gets it wide of third man, Nayar with a sprint and a sprawling dive saves the boundary
slower one coming in, turned through square leg, man from the deep runs in and keeps them to one
not getting the single, pushes a length ball to short extra and sets off, Pollard tells him to go back
overpitched on the pads, turned softly behind square leg
a slower one now, some display of variety from Marsh, Pollard hit high on the pad as he fails to turn it to leg
yorker, on the stumps, Pollard gets legs out of the way and keeps it out
short of a length and angled down the leg side
and he's needed one ball to strike, and DK is the man to go, offcutter coming in a long way, hitting him in front as he comes forward, not much doubt about that
dropped by his Mumbai team-mate and friend Nayar, who makes a good fist of it as he runs in from sweeper cover and dives forward but the mistimed lofted drive pops out
gets the bouncer, and weaves out of the line
hangs the bat out very late and picks up one to third man
he is placing them too easily in the gaps, wills a good length delivery away from the sweeper with a wristy punch
that was technically a chance, but Dinda did well to not be in the way when the drive rocketed straight back
nicely on top of the bounce to punch wide of sweeper cover and comes back for two
forward quickly but hits the drive into the pitch and takes the single as it dribbles down to long on
whips a full delivery down to long on
low full toss driven down to long off, serious timing on that from DK
overpitched on the stumps, he goes across and whips it wide of deep midwicket
short, into the body, DK has casually moved across and swung it over the fine leg boundary
chops a length ball coming in on off, behind point
flighted low full toss pushed wide of long on
Rohit in a tangle with one that straightens and comes on quickly around off and middle, rolls into pad and onto the pitch
flat, quick and short, he hasnt got hold of the pull, picks up one through midwicket
tries to run a quick and fullish one to third man, misses
comes out, sees the length is not quite full and cuts, to point
dabbed late wide of short third man
punched to short extra cover's right and stopped with a quick dash
pushed on the off side for a single
now he's lofted over extra cover, forward on the knee to the pitch and lovely connection, also becomes the leading run-getter again this season
that came in with the angle, bounced too, but DK is in another zone at the moment, where such deliveries are only to be smashed over midwicket with a quick pull
DK rushes up for  the single, but the ball has gone to shortish midwicket with Rohit's clip, and he's got to turn back
tossed up full, whipped against the turn to long on
skidding away widish, dabbed to short third
very full on off, patted down to the bowler
that skidded and bounced from good length, Rohit tried to punch it off the back foot, thick edge flies through vacant slip
shortish and quick outside off, cut hard, but Yuvraj stops it with a dive at backward point
holding its line outside off from a good length, he slaps it down to the sweeper
shot, DK displays the form he is, walks out, stops and swats a shortish delivery behind square leg
forward elegantly to open the face and runs it wide of point
full and angled in to off, he is moving forward and across and pushes it down the ground
reaches forward to a fullish delivery and works it past the non-striker, mid on gets around
short of a length, nice bounce, he is on the toes to drop it in front of cover
slow, on a good length, gentle, tight stuff, punched down to long on
flat, good length, some turn outside off, Rohit stays on the crease and punches to long off
nudged off the pad square on leg

excellent effort from Mitch Marsh on the edge of the long on boundary, looked like he'd lost it, but he's recovered to take it over his head and tumbled down hard with the effort, Finch slowing it down further and tossing it up, Sachin left the crease immediately to have a go, but wasn't to the pitch, had to reach out and ended up skying it
floated up low full toss on leg, he gets the front leg across, and bends to paddle it very fine
bounces from a good length now, pushed back to the bowler
slow and full, straightening outside off, defended
very flat to Tendulkar, who is neatly forward to push to long off
full, he drives down to long off to get off the mark
floated very full outside off, mistimed drive towards point

Has he got Ponting first ball? They are checking whether it carried to shortish backward point, it has been taken cleanly by the fielder low to his left, the question is whether Ponting drove it into the pitch first, replays show that ain't the case, and Yuvraj has broken the partnership
chips a length ball over the bowler, long on keeps them to one
overpitched, timed nicely, but the sweeper is in position
one more misfield, Pune losing it, Tendulkar whipping one from off to midwicket, where Rahul Sharma tumbles awkwardly and lets it through
the pull does not quite come off, this is a slow bouncer, Ponting does well to control it through square leg in the end
only seldom you see Tendulkar go after every ball, comes out and has a heave, thick edge flies down to third man
short, widish, he tries to upper cut, is beaten by the carry
makes some room and squeezes an overpitched ball to covers
and Tendulkar rubs it in, backing away and having another powerful swipe next ball, over deep midwicket
straightforward chance at mid on, Tendulkar slogs one in the air, it is dying on Yuvraj, not only does he make an absolute mess of it as he bends down, he allows it to go through him for four more
tossed up, mid on is straightish and Tendulkar's powerful drive is cut off by Yuvraj there
comes out and drives but finds deepish mid on
short and sitting up outside off, but he's slapped it to extra cover
straightens outside off, he is crisply forward to drive it wide of mid off for a single
turned eagerly from off but straight to midwicket
walks out and tries to blast an outswinger through the off side, misses, he means it today, really does
slow from a good length, he waits and turns it to square leg
pushed to cover
pitched up straight outside off, he comes forward and checks a push to the bowler
Tendulkar is racing away, clears front leg to a tossed up overpitched ball and slams it down the ground past the non-striker
quicker and very full on off, he leans across to turn it through midwicket
tossed up full outside off, he does not time the drive, picks one to wide long off
now he drags it very short, but Ponting's pull finds deep midwicket
flighted high full toss too, Ponting cannot put it away, pushes it to square leg
straightens on leg stump, loud shout from the bowler for lbw, turned down, marginal call, that was probably clipping leg
goes across looking to swing this short one away, but it bounces too much
moves across and outside off, opens the face to a length ball, finds point
four in four, Dinda overpitches, Sachin slams it powerfully past mid off's dive
pitched up, swinging away, Sachin pushes at it, thick edge flies in the air high and behind point
classic Tendulkar, good length delivery sent racing through extra cover with that back-foot punch
chance, very tough, Dinda overcompensating by floating one into the pads, Sachin flicks in the air, inches past Bhuvi's dive at short fine leg
pitched up, swinging away, starting too far outside off
pitched up, and now he's hesitant to get forward, moves across and plays it out from the crease
this came in as well, but was short, and that will do for Ponting, as he thumps it over midwicket with one of his pulls, one bounce and over
and again, alarming inswing for Bhuvneshwar, Ponting forward again, the ball sneaks in through the gate, this time Uthappa collects and appeals, in vain
chance, huge inswinger, Ponting sucked into the drive, it swerves in, takes a thin inside edge, but Uthappa is not able to get there with a dive
full, wide, he reaches it, and pushes, straight to backward point
now Ponting nearly pops one back to the bowler, this comes in sharply from back of a length, he tried turning it to leg, leading edge died halfway down the pitch
shortish, he goes for the pull, but he's not timed it all all, it loops just over mid on running to his right, and is stopped inside the rope with a slide
full, angled in, turned to midwicket
that almost popped back to the bowler, Sachin trying to paddle from off stump, got a leading edge
coming in with the angle, he stays on the crease and pushes to the bowler
comes forward and nudges a length ball to the leg side softly
flighted full toss, pushed to the leg side
Pollard ends with one more slower delivery, which is missed, and MI wrap up a comfortable win
slower one loops in the air down to long on
tries to dismiss it through extra cover but can;t put bat to ball
yet another slower one, floated up wide, he has a heave and misses
makes room and pushes another slower one in the air through cover
mishits a slow length ball through midwicket
moves to leg, Malinga goes outside off, and he misses one more
goes back and drills an overpitched ball straight down the ground
flicks a full one off the pad to fine leg
steered down to third man
full and quick just outside leg as he makes room, and another miss
misses a slower one outside off
slower length ball whipped over square leg, there is a fielder in the deep there
driven to sweeper cover for a single
slogs it down the ground, long on reaches it on the bounce
swings and misses outside off to a length ball
around the blockhole, turned square to leg
tries to heave it through the leg side, it is bowled slower, and bounces over the stumps
fast and into the body from back of a length, he tries to make room but it reaches him quickly
pitched full just outside off, pushed to short extra cover

MI have been top drawer with their catching, here's another one, Marsh slicing it into the sky over sweeper cover, Dhawan settled under it, seemed to lose the ball as it came down but tumbled to take it safely in the end
length ball going across, steered to third man
very low full toss, he swings and inside-edges to short fine leg
low full toss, Marsh shovels that high over extra cover
slow around the blockhole, he is leaning forward early and working it towards leg, Malinga quick to deny the run
pats a pitched up delivery down the track
full, wide and squeezed out to deep point
Nayar has succeeded in holing out this time, to long off, tried to get under this very full one and loft it, picked out Pollard
belts a quick pitched up delivery down to long off
very full just outside off, squeezed out to the sweeper
Nayar almost finding the man at mid off this time, with a drive in the air
drives a pitched up ball to sweeper cover
four more, Marsh makes room and swings, top edge flies high over the keeper
Marsh hitting a few late ones for PWI, golf-swings a length ball 99 metres into the crowd over forward square leg boundary
backs away and mistimes a swat to extra cover
pitched up outside off, Nayar whacks it in the air, just past extra cover
on the front foot to push to the off side for one
full, crashed down the ground to long off
slapped away to sweeper cover
quicker and fuller and closer to the stumps, hit down to long off
flighted wider, and this time he;s connected, and slog swept it big over deep midwicket
heaves at a tossed up offbreak, misses and is hit on the thigh pad
swatted down to long on
tried to back away for the cut, but that spun in to him and he has to dab it behind point
pitches on leg and turns down the leg side
goes back and across and swats it through midwicket
square drives one outside off, and comes back for two

Angelo holes out, not to the pitch as he skips out to a tossed up ball which dips, goes through with the shot, Rohit settles under the steepler, and as casually as he hits cover drives, he takes the catch too, Jonty Rhodes sitting right behind in the dugout claps
tossed up delivery, and first ball on return, Ojha's been heaved for a six over deep midwicket
bouncer, just outside off, Marsh moves across, stops, drops wrists and weaves out of the line
turns a pacy length ball to fine leg
pitched up outside off, driven to the sweeper
whips a length ball past midwicket
hops across to a back of a length ball and nudges it square to leg
turns a full toss to deep midwicket
pitched up, lifted over the bowler's head, long off fields
nice teasing outswinger, he goes for the drive and is beaten
he backs away to leg, Dhawan bowls it slow and full one off, dragged through midwicket
length ball, he brings bat around front pad to nudge it through square leg
almost chops it on as he makes some room, it bounces over, keeper runs in, and lobs it at the stumps, but Marsh is too quick
moves across and times it off the pads through midwicket, long on runs around
pushes a back of a length ball to the sweeper
pushed in from wide of the crease, Pollard has a shout but that hit him too high
he;s connected with another one, but has found Dhawan at deep midwicket, Dhawan ran in first, it came zooming into him, and he adjusted well to hold on
Yuvraj's creamed that through extra cover, the ones he plays when he is on song in a big ODI innings, sweeper dives to save the boundary
flicked to short fine off the pad
bends to off and tries to scoop it fine on leg, misses the length ball angled in
Yuvraj's reply is to cart the next one, a length ball, several rows over the long on boundary
beats Yuvraj again outside off as he misses a dab to a length ball
pitched up, on off, pushed wide of point
charges out and smashes this past the bowler, Rohit runs across from long in and dives to stop the boundary
that moved away sharply, full outside off, beats the edge by a mile
pitched up on the stumps, 130.8 kph, he is late on it but turns it through square leg
reaches out and opens the face to lift this one over cover for a couple
defends a length ball to off, and bowler denies them the single
that's gone over deep backward square leg, short and sitting up, and Yuvraj swivels to pull it high
that bounced and cut in from back of a length, he adjusted to arch back and steer to third man
turned in the air, almost carries to short midwicket
good length, but pushed down the leg side
Yuvraj dealing in thick edges, comes forward to this length ball, which scurries to short third man, some confusion before they cross over
129.6 kph, pitched up on the stumps, pushed to mid off for one
Yuvraj gets away, makes room and swings at a length delivery, thick edge beats the keeper's drive
beaten as he flashes at one leaving him outside off with the angle
good length, right on off stump, defended to the bowler, not a bad start for Dhawan
skiddy from back of a length, swatted down to long on
nice start, holds its line from a length on off, and zooms past the outside edge, Ponting likes that
pushes an offbreak down to long on
fired in and straightens on off, defended off the back foot
almost done in by one that comes in with the angle from round the stumps, thick inside edge past the stumps as Yuvraj pushes forward
big turn wide outside off, slapped away to extra cover
end of the fun for Suman, and a wicket for Harbhajan, who tosses it up once more, and Suman lofts it to Pollard at long in some way in from the boundary
Harbhajan starts the over with a flighted one, Suman comes out and looks to lift it over the off side, slices it over backward point
caught in the crease and awkwardly runs a length ball to third man
away swinger, good length, bouncing, he is beaten as he tries to dab it to third man
pitched up widish, and he puts it away through cover, Suman playing some cracking shots
hit on the pads with a big inswinger, but well outside leg stump
bouncing on him from short of a length, he stays beside it and runs it to third man
opens the face and steers a back of a length ball to third man
pushed to mid on
too much leg side from Harbhajan as he continues darting them in, Suman sweeps in the air to the fine leg rope
fired a rocket in from a good length, hits him on the thigh pad
some spin in, punched to the bowler
straighter one on off, pushed down the pitch
quick and full on the stumps, pushed to extra cover off a leading edge
thick edge to third man as he pushes forward to one that goes across
short, wide, and cut hard past point, Harbhajan at third man has no chance again
opens the face and runs a back of a length ball wide of point, that;s timed so well third man gives up

Mitch is through another one, inswinger working big time, Uthappa tries to straight drive a good length delivery, he ends up pushing outside the line as Mitch sneaks in one more, off stump, it's time for evening walk
hits the pad as he fails to work it to leg with the swing
swings in and hits the inner half o the blade as he tries to drive through off
moves across to one straightening on middle and turns it square
pushed through down the leg side
makes room now to a quicker one on the stumps and runs it to point
shortish once more, neat bounce, and Uthappa can't time the punch, but he;s got it in the gap at cover
shortish, and he opens up to pull it high over square leg
defended off the front foot

what a waste, more trouble for Pune, Uthappa pulls to square leg, Taylor wants the single, he is too far up the pitch before he turns back, Ojha makes a mess initially of the take as the throw arrives, but still has enough time to catch Taylor short
back of a length, pushed quietly to extra cover
angled across on off stump, pushed off the front foot to covers
swings in on middle stump, softly played out to midwicket
swings in from good length now, and carries down the leg side
full and straightening just outside off, Taylor doing well to squeeze it past point
inswinger again, this time around off stump, pushed to the leg side
bowled him first ball, full and fast inswinger, and Finch has played all around it, what a ripper to get first up
